scripts.build: pnpm --filter @poker-champ/realtime-contract build && node scripts/retry-prisma-generate.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.preflight:client: pnpm --filter @poker-champ/realtime-contract build && pnpm sdk:check && pnpm -C apps/client typecheck && pnpm -C apps/client lint && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:client:money-safety
scripts.test:client:money-safety: pnpm --prefix apps/client exec vitest run src/tests/table.adapter.money.test.ts
scripts.test:server:bot:heatmap:profiles:update: set UPDATE_HEATMAP=1&& vitest run src/tests/tight-passive-heatmap.test.ts src/tests/loose-aggressive-heatmap.test.ts src/tests/loose-passive-heatmap.test.ts
scripts.test:server:bot:heatmap:profiles:assert: set HEATMAP_ASSERT=1&& vitest run src/tests/tight-passive-heatmap.test.ts src/tests/loose-aggressive-heatmap.test.ts src/tests/loose-passive-heatmap.test.ts
scripts.test:server:rejoin: vitest run src/tests/session-policy.test.ts src/tests/table-join.guard.test.ts src/tests/table-action-broadcast.test.ts src/tests/reconnection.invariant.test.ts src/tests/player-lifecycle.removal-bet-sync.test.ts src/tests/fold-path-equivalence.test.ts
scripts.test:server:core: pnpm test:server:join && pnpm test:server:broadcast && pnpm test:server:money-safety
scripts.realtime:check: pnpm -C packages/realtime-contract typecheck && pnpm server:typecheck && pnpm -C apps/client typecheck
scripts.sdk:gen: pnpm openapi:export && node scripts/sync-sdk-version.mjs && npx openapi-typescript openapi.json -o packages/sdk/src/types.gen.ts
scripts.madge: madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx src apps/client/src packages/sdk/src packages/realtime-contract/src
scripts.verify: pnpm sdk:check && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:client:money-safety && pnpm test:server:core && pnpm test:server:soak && pnpm realtime:check && pnpm harness:headless && pnpm ui:no-fetch && pnpm knip && pnpm madge
